prompts.title: The Red Exit
prompts.prompt:
Create a high-detail, textured graphic-novel portrait (not vector, not clean illustration).

FRAME (LOCK):
Chest-up shot. Subject fills ~75-80% frame. Positioned slightly right.
Lower left side must have some clear empty space. Do not zoom in or crop tight.

POSE (HARD LOCK):
Body facing left (back visible) side in the frame.
Left shoulder closer to camera.
Head turned back over left shoulder, looking directly at viewer.
Face angle ~30–40° (not front-facing).
Maintain strong shoulder depth. Do NOT flatten body.

EXPRESSION:
Intense, serious, slightly intimidating.
Tight jaw. Focused eyes. Brow compressed.

LIGHTING (FORCE THIS):
Single hard light from upper-left.
– bright highlight on: left forehead, cheekbone, nose bridge
– light strip on front suit (lapel area)
– right side of face = deep shadow (near black)
– sharp shadow edge across face (clear light/shadow split)
No soft light. No even lighting. No ambient fill.

STYLE (ANTI-VECTOR):
Textured ink rendering, not clean digital art.
Subject must be rendered entirely in black and white (grayscale only), using pure black, white, and grey tones. No skin color or natural color tones allowed.
– slightly rough edges
– visible grain/noise
– layered linework (thick + thin + micro)
– hair = individual strands, messy flow
Avoid smooth, clean, vector-like finish.

SHADING:
Halftone only in shadow zones + subtle grain overlay
No gradients. No flat fills.
SUIT:
Black tailored suit
– visible folds and tension lines
– sharp shoulder crease
– highlight edge on front
– no flat black areas
SHIRT:
White shirt

BACKGROUND (IMPORTANT):
No straight split. No centered division.
– left: very light grey (flat, clean, minimal texture)
– right: rich saturated red
The transition must feel like red paint has burst into the grey:
– irregular, broken, organic boundary (not a straight line)
– uneven paint edges with slight bleed into grey
– grey area mostly clean with minor invasion near boundary
SPLASH (DETAIL):
High-density layered splatter:
– large & medium irregular splashes (explosive shapes, not circular)
– medium scattered drops
– very fine micro particles (dust-like spray, clearly visible)
– directional spray patterns (not uniform)
– higher density on red side, gradually reducing toward grey
– mix of red and black splatter
– subtle splatter interaction on subject’s back/shoulder edge
– avoid symmetry, avoid pattern repetition

AVOID:
front pose, soft lighting, smooth gradients, vector style, flat shading, skin color, centered subject, clean vertical split.
Aspect ratio 4:5

prompts.title: Life in Panels
prompts.prompt:
Create a striking mixed-media composition featuring a high-resolution photographic portrait of a reference man standing in front of a large, wall-sized black-and-white manga collage. The image should visually represent the “multifaceted” or “multiverse” nature of the subject’s personality.

Framing & Scale: Subject occupies approximately 60–80% of the frame height, positioned perfectly centered in a vertical 2:3 composition

Expression: Natural smile or calm confidence

Pose: Standing in the center foreground with a relaxed posture, hands casually in pockets, legs slightly crossed at the ankles

Attire (Adaptive): Modern casual outfit (e.g., denim jacket or minimalist jacket over a plain white t-shirt, paired with fitted jeans or trousers, clean footwear). Keep styling contemporary, clean, and realistic

Lighting: Bright, professional studio lighting with soft shadows, ensuring strong subject-background separation and a crisp, high-end photographic look

Background (Manga Collage World)

Style: Classic Japanese manga aesthetic — bold black ink lines, screentone textures (halftone dots), high contrast, and dynamic speed lines

Color: Strictly black-and-white manga style (no color in background)

Narrative Panels (Same Subject as Manga Character)

The background collage features multiple manga panels depicting alternate versions of the same man in different life scenarios:

Riding a motorcycle with dynamic speed lines and “VROOM” text

Focused and working at a desk or computer setup

Walking through a busy urban street scene

Using a smartphone or camera (vlogging/selfie perspective)

Laughing or interacting with friends, expressive and social

Enjoying time with family (He with his partner and two children)

Include a mix of Japanese onomatopoeia (e.g., ドキドキ, バン) and English sound effects integrated naturally into panels.

Composition & Contrast

Strong visual contrast between:

Foreground: ultra-realistic, high-detail photographic subject

Background: flat, stylized, monochrome manga world

Seamless depth separation — subject should “pop” clearly from the background

Environment & Final Details

Clean white floor with subtle shadow grounding the subject

Balanced composition with cinematic depth

Mood: modern, empowered, dynamic, and aspirational — representing ambition, creativity, and social energy

Strictly maintain high-fidelity facial structure and exact likeness from the reference image. Integrate the face naturally with the scene's lighting. Ensure realistic skin texture with visible pores and minor imperfections; absolutely avoid overly smooth AI skin or a pasted face-swap look.

prompts.title: Weekend vibes with Puss in Boots
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image strictly as a face and identity reference for the human subject only. Create a relaxed, premium studio fashion portrait with a natural, confident editorial feel. The real human stands casually in a full-body pose, weight shifted onto one leg, the other leg crossed slightly at the ankle, wearing an oatmeal beige textured knitted sweater, dark indigo high-waisted jeans, and clean white low-top sneakers. The human has a calm, friendly natural smile and relaxed posture, with one arm bent naturally at the elbow and resting gently on the shoulder of a true human-scale photorealistic 3D animated character, Puss in Boots. Other hand in her jeans pocket.
Puss in Boots stands upright beside the human at realistic height, arms crossed confidently across his chest, leaning subtly toward the human to create natural chemistry. He is rendered as a highly detailed, cinematic 3D character with realistic ginger fur texture, soft volume, and visible strand detail, expressive large green eyes, and a confident, slightly mischievous expression. He wears his signature leather wide-brim hat, belt, and worn boots, all textured with realistic leather grain and subtle aging.
The interaction feels casual and authentic, as if the human is comfortably resting an arm on a trusted companion rather than posing stiffly. Composition is a clean 3/4 to full-body framing with both subjects fully visible. The background is a smooth warm taupe or neutral studio backdrop with no distractions. Lighting is soft, professional studio lighting with gentle key light and subtle rim light that enhances facial features, clothing fabric, and fur detail without harsh shadows. High-end fashion editorial aesthetic, natural color grading, sharp focus, realistic proportions, premium portrait quality, cinematic realism.

prompts.title: The Analog Rebel
prompts.prompt:
Use the reference image for 100% facial identity accuracy with no alteration to facial structure.

Create a full-body, wide-angle studio portrait with a retro analog aesthetic, full view with no cropping, preserving all visible elements and spacing. Aspect ratio 4:5 vertical.

A young adult man sits directly on the studio floor in a relaxed, natural pose. His legs are fully extended and spread wide toward the camera, with chunky black platform boots clearly visible in the foreground, appearing slightly larger due to the wide-angle lens (approx. 24–28mm). He wears a black leather biker jacket, black ribbed knit sweater, and black trousers. He has white oval sunglasses fully covering his eyes and a white candy stick (cigarette-like) held loosely between his lips. Hair is dark, slightly tousled, with realistic skin texture and subtle stubble.

He leans casually to his left, resting against a medium-sized vintage CRT television placed on the floor beside him. The TV has a brown wooden casing, silver bezel, and displays static noise on the screen. A black power cable extends from the TV toward the right side of the frame.
His left elbow rests on top of the TV, with the left forearm hanging naturally down the front edge, fingers relaxed and slightly curled. His right hand rests loosely on the floor near his inner thigh, relaxed and unposed. His head tilts to his right, chin slightly lifted, giving a laid-back, introspective expression.

On the floor in the foreground, many objects are clearly visible:
A dense cluster of silver compact discs scattered between and in front of his legs, overlapping naturally. Several black cassette tapes are mixed into the CD cluster, along with two small black portable tape players (Walkman-style) placed near the right side of the pile. All objects remain grounded, naturally spaced, and confined to the lower portion of the frame.

The setting is a minimal studio with a seamless wall and floor in the same tone. The background features a smooth cool teal-grey color palette, slightly lighter toward the upper left and subtly darker toward the lower right. No props or distractions beyond what is visible.

Lighting is soft and directional from the front-left and slightly above, creating gentle shadows on the subject’s right side and behind the TV. Subtle reflections appear on the sunglasses, leather jacket, and CDs. The image has muted colors, a cool, subdued tone, fine film grain, and a slight vintage analog look.

Ultra-detailed, photorealistic, natural proportions, realistic textures. Use the reference image for accurate pose, object placement, color tone, and facial structure.

Negative Prompt: cropped body, missing legs, missing CDs, oversized TV, wrong pose, incorrect hand placement, exaggerated expressions, oversaturated colors, HDR, CGI look, blur, distortion, extra limbs, watermark, text, logo

prompts.title: GTA V Artwork
prompts.prompt:
Create a GTA V loading-screen style illustration using the uploaded photo as 100% exact face match (no changes to facial structure/skin/beard/eyes). A young man crouches on a cracked rooftop, one arm resting on his knee, looking directly at the camera. Outfit: black textured sweatshirt, dark jeans, bright red high-top sneakers.

Color tone & graphics: vibrant sunset gradient sky (orange/yellow near horizon → pink/purple → deep blue), warm golden backlight from the left, plus a cool cyan rim light outline around the character. Use bold comic-style outlines, clean cel-shading, sharp highlights, high-contrast poster look, hyper-detailed textures.

Background: Los Santos–style skyline, palm trees, graffiti wall, urban rooftop details. Add “GTA FIVE” logo at the top-left. Ultra-sharp, HD.
